verdict.rationale: Sumsub's MCP server docs state that AI agent access is 'controlled by your existing Sumsub role permissions,' implying agents can be restricted via the platform's role-based access system rather than full account access, and team-member role management further supports granular permissioning. However, there is no explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege API tokens or keys (e.g., token-level scopes, expiring credentials) issued specifically for agents beyond reusing existing dashboard roles. Missing for 10: dedicated API-key/token scoping mechanism for agents, granular permission documentation for MCP/agent use, independent verification of least-privilege enforcement.
